core_obligations: Build the category of factorizations and show it is directed (proof lines 1452-1481): consider the category whose objects are the factorizations A -> B -> C-bar with A -> B etale; it is nonempty through A -> A -> C-bar, closed under the tensor product over A of two objects, and closed under coequalizers of parallel pairs by the stability of etale algebras, so it is a directed category.

Identify C/IC with C-bar (proof lines 1483-1503): writing C-bar as a filtered colimit of etale A/I-algebras and lifting each to an etale A-algebra shows that C -> C-bar is surjective; since C/IC -> C-bar is ind-etale, hence flat, C-bar is a localization of C/IC at a multiplicative subset, and the chosen elements are inverted in the colimit, so C/IC = C-bar.

Compute the Hom sets (proof lines 1505-1516): for an ind-etale A-algebra D written as a filtered colimit of etale D_i, any A/I-algebra map D/ID -> C-bar induces a map of diagrams into the category of factorizations, hence a map D -> C compatible with the maps to C-bar, which gives the identification Mor_A(D, C) = Mor_{A/I}(D/ID, C-bar).

Define the adjoint and conclude (proof lines 1518-1527): the rule sending C-bar to the colimit of the B over the factorizations is therefore a right adjoint v to the base change functor u, and it is fully faithful because u composed with v is the identity by construction.
proof_roadmap: Show that the factorizations of the base change along etale A-algebras form a directed category.
Identify the colimit with the given ind-etale algebra modulo the ideal.
Compute the Hom sets to establish the adjunction, and conclude full faithfulness from the identity u v = id.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a ring A and an ideal I, the base change functor from ind-etale A-algebras to ind-etale A/I-algebras has a fully faithful right adjoint, so that every ind-etale A/I-algebra lifts to one over A (statement lines 1437-1450). The proof (proof lines 1452-1516) exhibits the lift as a filtered colimit over the directed category of factorizations through etale A-algebras, proves that the colimit reduces to the given algebra modulo the ideal, computes the Hom sets to get the adjunction, and reads off full faithfulness. H3: an original construction-and-computation argument with four inputs, written out in full.
